value: Google Earth VR is a free, immersive virtual reality application that allows users to explore the globe from unique perspectives. Users can freely navigate major cities, iconic landmarks, and natural wonders, flying over metropolises, standing on mountain peaks, or even venturing into space. It also includes pre-curated cinematic tours and hand-picked destinations. Highly acclaimed with multiple awards, including "Best HTC Vive Experience," and boasting "Very Positive" user reviews, Google Earth VR offers an expansive and accessible virtual travel experience for PC VR platforms.
